paper.title: Accounting for employee flows
paper.code_data_availability: DATA AVAILABILITY STATEMENT (p. 968): "This study employs proprietary registry data from Statistics Denmark on the firm and the personal level. …

registers.name_in_paper: Statistics Denmark's Integrated Database for Labor Market Research (IDAN database)
registers.role: treatment variables (employee arrivals and departures), employee controls, sample frame
variables_mentioned: salary received from the firm over the year
days of employment over a year

registers.name_in_paper: STILL (Statistics Denmark dataset of position codes)
registers.role: classification of employees into six within-firm position categories, used to build Departures Replaced and the promotion control
alternative within-firm position identifier used in robustness tests
outcomes and accounting controls: balance sheets and rudimentary accrual-based income statements of all Danish limited liability firms

registers.name_in_paper: Publicly available population-level data from Eurostat and the Danish Agency for Labor market and Recruitment
registers.role: external validation of the measured arrival and departure rates

registers.name_in_paper: Interest rate of Danish government bonds
registers.role: screen for implausible firm-level interest rates

linkages: Employees linked to firms through annual employment spells (firm-employee-year links) in IDAN
IDAN employee data merged with Orbis financial statement information at the firm level
Departures matched to arrivals within six STILL position categories within firm-year to build Departures Replaced

sample.universe: Danish limited liability firms with an employer-employee link in the IDAN database, 1998-2016 (estimation period 1999-2015)
selection_rules: Start from 1,325,130 firm-year observations with an employer-employee link (189,397 firms)
Drop 137,932 firm-years where Employee Departures or Employee Arrivals is missing (leaving 1,187,198 firm-years, 154,079 firms)
Drop 448,506 firm-years with missing values for test variables (leaving 738,692 firm-years, 105,779 firms)
Drop 495,239 firm-years with less than 10 employees (leaving 243,453 firm-years, 33,873 firms)

For the interest-rate analyses the sample is further reduced by truncating InterestRate at the fifth and 95th percentiles and coding as missing observations more than 10 percentage points above the Danish government bond rate (N = 160,189)
sample.period: 1999 to 2015 (data include lagged and leading variables, i.e. 1998-2016)
sample.n_observations: 243,453 firm-year observations (performance analyses); 160,189 firm-year observations (interest-rate analyses); 13,754,951 person-firm-year observations

construction_notes: Employee Arrivals (Employee Departures) is the number of arriving (departing) employees scaled by the lagged number of employees
Only employees who at some point received at least the minimum salary from the firm are counted
Accounting changes (ΔGross Profit, ΔOther Operating Expenses, ΔOperating Earnings, ΔCapEx) are scaled by lagged assets
Other operating expenses are defined as gross profit minus EBIT
All test and interest-rate variables are winsorized at the first and 99th percentiles
InterestRate = financial expenses / average interest-bearing debt, where interest-bearing debt = total liabilities minus trade payables; truncated at the fifth and 95th percentiles
Size variables in Table 2 are converted from DKK to EUR using an exchange rate of 7.45
Departures Replaced = number of arrivals that replace a departing employee within the same position category, divided by the total number of departures
SalaryQuartile is assigned by industry-year; departing employees are ranked on year t-1 salary and arriving employees on year t+1 salary
ln(EBIT/FiExp) is computed after adding the absolute value of the minimum of EBIT/FiExp because interest coverage can be negative

claims.statement: In the pooled sample, Employee Departures is negatively associated with the one-year-ahead change in gross profit.

register_source.value: IDAN (Statistics Denmark's Integrated Database for Labor Market Research): annual employment spells, i.e. firm-employee-year links with salary received from the firm and days of employment

definition.value: The number of employees leaving the firm in a given year scaled by the number of employees at the beginning of the year. Departing employees are individuals who receive salary from the firm in year t but not in year t+1; only employees who at some point received at least the minimum salary are counted. Winsorized at the first and 99th percentiles.

timing.value: measured in year t, before the outcome change from t to t+1

register_source.value: Orbis database (Bureau van Dijk) financial statements of Danish limited liability firms; not a Statistics Denmark register

definition.value: The change in gross profits scaled by lagged assets, measured from year t to year t+1. Winsorized at the first and 99th percentiles.

timing.value: change from year t to year t+1

units.value: change in ΔGross Profit_{t+1} (scaled by lagged assets) per one-unit change in Employee Departures_t (employees flowing, scaled by beginning-of-year employees)

estimand.target_population: Danish limited liability firm-years, 1999-2015, with an employer-employee link, non-missing employee flow and test variables and at least 10 employees (pooled sample)
estimand.time_horizon: the change in the outcome from year t to year t+1, i.e. one year ahead of the employee flow
